item.title: 'Folk 😭' Has Replaced 'Son 😭' In Many Ironic Image Macros, Mostly Because Of One Instagram User
item.description: Folk 😭 refers to a caption in a series of image macros and reaction images, which conveys crying laughing, emodied by the loudly crying face emoji, 😭, and the word "folk."

item.title: Anime Characters Dance Their Hearts Out In TikTok's 'Dance With Me' Trend
item.description: Dance With Me or Ichi, Ichi, Ichi, also known as the KORE (Slowed Down) Trend is a TikTok meme trend set to "KORE (Ultra Slowed)" by Zynyx where GIFs and animations of various characters are shown dancing in the comment sections of TikTok videos after someone comments, "Dance with me," "Dance whit me" or "Let's dance." The trend was popularized in mid-December 2025 by TikToker @nurkhan_ib and became notably popular that month as users uploaded similar videos of characters dancing to the song.

item.title: Joey Diaz And Joe Rogan Discussing The Horrors Of Eating 'Cream Cheese On A Roll' Goes Viral
item.description: Cream Cheese and Jelly On A Roll is a viral video and audio clip of comedian and podcaster Joey Diaz talking to Joe Rogan about how he used to eat cream cheese and jelly on a poppy seed roll for breakfast, talking about how bad it is for the body. In July 2025, an edit of Diaz and Joe discussing the meal was posted to the Rogan Extra's YouTube channel. The edit went viral on TikTok in December of that year as the subject of brainrot edits and memes.

item.description: There is no escaping the word "folk" on Instagram at the moment, all because of a select few irony pages that have pasted it on every meme. Here's why.

item.title: Beedrill's 'String Shot' Attack Inspires A Flurry Of Naughty Memes On Twitter
item.description: The Beedrill String Shot GIF or Beedrill GIF is an animation of the Pokémon Beedrill using the attack string shot, causing a string of silk to shoot from its stinger, from the Nintendo 64 video game Pokémon Stadium. The animation went viral on X / Twitter in December 2025 as the subject of fan art, memes and reactions, with many finding the GIF funny as it resembles Beedrill ejaculating.
